name: perplexity
description: Read-only Perplexity CLI + client lib: Search API (raw web results, flat-rate) and Agent API (Claude with live web search); every call is paid, so in-code ceilings, --explain cost pre-flight and an audit line per request
surface: read-only CLI `pplx search` / `pplx agent` + importable `lib/perplexity.js`; both endpoints only read the web; spend bounded by code ceilings (20 results, 4096 output tokens), `--explain` prices a call before it is made, one audit line per paid request

origin.note: the hello-perplexity workshop (lib/, examples/, docs/); the research-*.js one-off scripts and their JSON output were untracked there and are not vendored

install.description: Install dotenv locally — only examples/*.js import it
install.why: the examples load a .env with `import 'dotenv/config'`; pplx.mjs and lib/ have no dependencies and run without this step
install.yes: node_modules/ is created inside tools/perplexity; no call to Perplexity is made
install.no: skipped; the CLI and tests still work, the examples fail on import until you run it

env.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
env.description: Your Perplexity API key (pplx-…), from perplexity.ai/settings/api; billed to your own account. Alternative: ~/.config/toolbelt/perplexity.key mode 600 (a looser mode is refused)

auth.flow: Static API key the operator creates in the Perplexity console, billed to their own account; read from $PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, else a 600-mode key file outside the tree. Nothing is cached; there is no login verb
auth.login: Create a key at https://www.perplexity.ai/settings/api, then: export PERPLEXITY_API_KEY=pplx-… — or: mkdir -p ~/.config/toolbelt && printf '%s\n' pplx-… > ~/.config/toolbelt/perplexity.key && chmod 600 ~/.config/toolbelt/perplexity.key

caches.note: optional 600-mode key file; resolveKey() in lib/perplexity.js refuses group/world-readable modes; an in-tree .env (gitignored) is the examples' deprecated fallback

safeguards: Read-only by construction: both endpoints (/search, /v1/agent) return web results and nothing on the Perplexity side is created, changed or deleted; the CLI exposes no other endpoint (SENSIBILITIES #1)

In-code ceilings in lib/constants.js CEILINGS, enforced by assertCeiling() in lib/perplexity.js and pplx.mjs: 20 search results, 5 batch queries, 20000 search tokens, 4096 agent output tokens, 4096 chat tokens; a value above one is refused with exit 2, not lowered; max_output_tokens is always sent (default 2048) so no call's price is unbounded (SENSIBILITIES #3)
--explain pre-flight in pplx.mjs prints the exact request with the key redacted and the worst-case dollar cost at the ceilings, and makes no call (SENSIBILITIES #5)

Audit line to stderr on every paid request — request() in lib/perplexity.js: timestamp, endpoint, model, HTTP status, elapsed ms, input/output/total tokens and cost when the API reports them, the error text on failure; never the key, query or response (SENSIBILITIES #7)
Per-request timeouts (30 s search, 120 s agent) via AbortSignal.timeout; 401, 429, timeout and network failure each get one plain sentence and exit 1, no retries (SENSIBILITIES #8)
Key from $PERPLEXITY_API_KEY or ~/.config/toolbelt/perplexity.key only; resolveKey() refuses a group/world-readable key file; the key is never printed, logged or placed on argv (SENSIBILITIES #11)

verbs.name: search
verbs.note: POST /search — raw ranked web results + citations, flat $0.005 per call; --limit ≤ 20, domain/recency/date filters

verbs.name: agent
verbs.note: POST /v1/agent — Claude (Sonnet default; opus/haiku aliases) with Perplexity web search; token-priced, ≈$0.02 typical, ≤≈$0.11 at the ceilings; --explain shows the worst case first

verbs.name: chat / reason / deepResearch (Sonar models)
verbs.note: library functions retained in lib/perplexity.js for reference and importers; no CLI verb — the house rule is search()+agent() only; deep research can take minutes and dollars per call

risk.worst_case: spends the operator's own Perplexity credit: at most ≈$0.005 per search and ≈$0.11 per agent call at the in-code ceilings, each call audited to stderr with its actual cost

checks.fix: cd {TOOLBELT}/tools/perplexity && npm install   (or: toolbelt setup perplexity) — only the examples need it; pplx.mjs and the tests do not

checks.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
checks.label: Perplexity API key present ($PERPLEXITY_API_KEY or a 600-mode ~/.config/toolbelt/perplexity.key)
checks.fix: Create a key at https://www.perplexity.ai/settings/api, then export PERPLEXITY_API_KEY=… or write it to ~/.config/toolbelt/perplexity.key (chmod 600)

smoke_test.command: node pplx.mjs search smoke test --explain >/dev/null && node pplx.mjs agent smoke test --explain >/dev/null && node --test test/*.test.mjs
smoke_test.expect: both pre-flights render without a key and without a call; 8 unit tests green (ceilings, parsing, key-file refusal, audit line) — no node_modules needed
